name: Notion Education Plan
benefit: Free Education plan for a one-member workspace, with unlimited uploads, 30-day version history and up to 100 guests.
eligibility: Students or educators at accredited colleges and universities recognized by WHED, using a valid primary institutional email.
duration: Reverify the education email annually to retain the benefit.
restrictions: Not offered to K-12 users under this higher-education plan. Extra workspace members disqualify the individual plan; losing eligibility returns to Free.
